title: 1980s school picture day
summary: Your selfie as a 1980s school photo: mottled blue backdrop, soft light and a slightly awkward smile.
why: 1980s-style portraits have been one of the biggest AI photo trends since September, and the school-photo version gets a lot of shares because everyone remembers picture day.
steps: Use a selfie where you're looking straight at the camera.
Try the laser backdrop version for a glamour look.

prompts.label: Main prompt
prompts.text: Use my attached photo and keep my face recognisable. Turn it into a 1980s school picture day photo: a mottled blue-grey studio backdrop, soft flat flash, a slightly awkward closed-mouth smile, head tilted a little to one side. I'm wearing a chunky knit sweater over a collared shirt, with a slightly too-neat 1980s hairstyle. Faded colour film, soft focus, a thin white border like a printed wallet photo. Vertical 4:5.

prompts.label: Variation: laser backdrop
prompts.text: Same photo, but as a 1980s glamour studio portrait: a dark backdrop with blue and purple laser beams, big voluminous hair, a shiny satin jacket, soft-focus glow, a dreamy hazy look. Keep my face recognisable. 4:5.

prompts.label: Variation: team photo
prompts.text: Use the attached photo of our team (everyone has agreed). Keep every face recognisable. Make it a 1980s company photo: everyone in matching polo shirts with the company name stitched on, standing in two rows in front of the shop, faded film colours, soft flash, a printed white border. 4:5.

tips: Say "keep my face recognisable". Era edits often change faces more than other styles.
Post your real photo and the 1980s one side by side.
The team version is a fun "throwback Thursday" post for small businesses.
